SELECT genetic_profile.STABLE_ID as "molecularProfileId", sample.STABLE_ID as "sampleId", patient.STABLE_ID as "patientId", single_cell_expression.ENTREZ_GENE_ID as "entrezGeneId", cancer_study.CANCER_STUDY_IDENTIFIER AS "studyId", single_cell_expression.TISSUE as "tissue", single_cell_expression.CELL_TYPE as "cellType", single_cell_expression.EXPRESSION_VALUE as "expressionValue"
FROM single_cell_expression INNER JOIN genetic_profile ON single_cell_expression.GENETIC_PROFILE_ID = genetic_profile.GENETIC_PROFILE_ID INNER JOIN sample ON single_cell_expression.SAMPLE_ID = sample.INTERNAL_ID INNER JOIN patient ON sample.PATIENT_ID = patient.INTERNAL_ID INNER JOIN cancer_study ON patient.CANCER_STUDY_ID = cancer_study.CANCER_STUDY_ID
